findings.text: The magnetics map binds PSRC Ip with unit_factor 1.0, but the reviewed node's own SPEC and plan section 5 as of the reviewed base (a9518f2d) both required kA with a declared unit factor of 1000 (prompt.txt line 88 clause 4; plan html 'PSRC/Ip in kA ... with a declared unit factor of 1000'). The delivered binding is nevertheless physically correct: I read the on-demand cache read-only and the PSRC/Ip array carries attrs {units: A} with peak |Ip| = 998576.25 A (~1 MA flat top) on the plasma shot 101154, so a 1000 factor would serve ~1 GA. The plan was corrected to unit factor 1 on main at commit 520f5340 ('bind JT-60SA PSRC Ip in amperes, unit factor 1'), so the spec/code disagreement is already reconciled upstream. Recorded so a coordinator sees that the node deviated from its SPEC-as-written (a reportable deviation under the exact-SPEC rule) and is independently corroborated rather than asserted.

The blocked row for cur2TFLKAT gives the reason 'duplicate of tf_coil_TF1_current; the second TF chain is not served'. The 'duplicate' characterisation does not hold on the cached shots: on E060033 cur2TFLKAT is a dead channel (every sample exactly 0.0) while cur1TFLKAT reads 25.7 kA, and on E101154 the two chains both peak near 23.3 kA but correlate only 0.646 over the cached window (max|cur1-cur2|/max|cur1| = 0.0091), so cur2 is not a faithful copy of cur1 there. Blocking one chain per signal is correct and the map's own evidence string correctly states cur2 reads zero on E060033, but the reason's 'duplicate' wording misdescribes the second chain's status (dead on one shot, similar-but-not-identical on the other).

The nine non-EF6 coils are served from the LKAT chain and the blocked rows name the unmet condition as 'a validated chain-selection verdict that distinguishes HiTe from LKAT for coil CSn'. On the plasma shot E101154 I reproduced the map's per-coil agreement exactly (max|HiTe-LKAT|/max|LKAT|: CS1 0.0724, CS2 0.0504, CS3 0.0729, CS4 0.0647, EF1 0.1231, EF2 0.0810, EF3 0.0645, EF4 0.0578, EF5 0.0554, EF6 0.2947; min corr 0.9948 at EF6, all others >= 0.9987), so EF6 is correctly the sole circuit beyond 15% and is served from HiTe. The other two cached shots cannot corroborate the choice: on E101173 and E060033 the PF coil currents sit at the noise floor (|I| of order 10-100 A, chains uncorrelated apart from EF2 on E101173 at 1496 A, which agrees at 0.103/corr 0.9996). The record documents no reason to prefer LKAT over HiTe for the nine agreeing coils beyond 'the choice rests on how the two agree'; the latter is true and disclosed as unvalidated, so this is a rationale gap rather than a wrong binding.
